Overview of Professional Opportunities in Hyderabad

Recent professional listings indicate ongoing recruitment activities within the global mobility and immigration sectors in Hyderabad. Organizations such as Deloitte have outlined specialized roles focusing on US immigration support and Program Electronic Review Management (PERM) processes.

Key Responsibilities and Scope

Based on published position descriptions for immigration support services, typical responsibilities in this domain generally encompass:

  • Supporting administrative and procedural activities related to the PERM process.
  • Tracking case progress using internal tracking tools, vendor systems, and platforms such as SharePoint or Salesforce.
  • Maintaining records, monitoring timelines, and coordinating with internal stakeholders and external legal counsel.
